documents.title: Northwind Health Clearinghouse - Healthcare connectivity APIs
documents.content:
# Northwind Health Clearinghouse
Northwind Health Clearinghouse provides healthcare connectivity APIs that help providers, payers and health technology companies exchange eligibility, claims and remittance data.
## Built for healthcare developers
Our platform replaces fragile batch file transfers with modern, developer-friendly REST APIs and real-time responses.
- Real-time insurance eligibility verification
- Electronic claims submission and status tracking
- Electronic remittance advice (ERA) delivery
Trusted by revenue cycle teams, digital health startups and regional health plans across the United States.

documents.title: Products - Northwind Health Clearinghouse
documents.content:
# Products
## Northwind Eligibility API
The Northwind Eligibility API returns real-time insurance eligibility and benefits information for patients. It is designed for provider organizations, billing companies and digital health applications that need answers before a visit.
- Sub-second responses for most major payers
- Sandbox environment for developers
## Northwind Claims Gateway
The Northwind Claims Gateway lets revenue cycle teams submit professional and institutional claims electronically, track claim status and receive remittance advice.
- Supports X12 837 claims and 835 remittance
- Integrations with practice management systems and EHR platforms
Pricing is available on request. Contact our team for a quote.

documents.title: About Northwind Health Clearinghouse
documents.content:
# About us
Northwind Health Clearinghouse was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Columbus, Ohio. We started with a simple idea: healthcare transactions should be as easy to integrate as payments.
## Our customers
We serve medical billing companies, physician practices, digital health companies and regional payers. Our mission is to remove administrative friction from healthcare revenue cycle workflows.

documents.title: Developer documentation - Northwind
documents.content:
# Developer documentation
The Northwind API is a REST API that accepts and returns JSON. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 client credentials.
The platform is hosted on AWS and supports FHIR R4 resources for clinical data exchange alongside X12 EDI transactions including 837 and 835.
Webhooks notify your application when claim status changes. A sandbox environment is available for testing.

documents.title: Northwind launches Eligibility API v2
documents.content:
# Northwind launches Eligibility API v2
Today we launched Northwind Eligibility API v2 with faster responses and expanded payer coverage. We also announced a partnership with Fabrikam Health Network to bring real-time eligibility checks to its member providers.
We are also opening a second office in Austin, Texas to support customer growth.

documents.title: Northwind Health Clearinghouse raises $20 million Series B
documents.content:
# Northwind Health Clearinghouse raises $20 million Series B
COLUMBUS, Ohio - Northwind Health Clearinghouse today announced it has raised $20 million in a Series B financing round led by Fabrikam Ventures, with participation from Adventure Works Capital.
The company has raised $32 million in total to date. Proceeds will fund product development and expansion of the sales and partnerships team in 2025.

documents.title: Healthcare clearinghouse market: new entrants challenge incumbents
documents.content:
Healthcare clearinghouse market: new entrants challenge incumbents
Northwind Health Clearinghouse is positioned as a developer-first alternative to Contoso Claims Exchange, the long-standing incumbent in claims connectivity. Analysts note that Northwind competes mainly for mid-market billing companies and digital health startups.
